import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator lines: contain no bg color
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if not any(g[i][j]==bg for j in range(w))]
    sc=[j for j in range(w) if not any(g[i][j]==bg for i in range(h))]
    # markers: cells not bg and not the dominant non-bg line color? use: cells whose color appears rarely
    # marker rows/cols: sep lines containing a rare color (color count small)
    rare={c:n for c,n in cnt.items() if n<=h}  # heuristic
    mr=[i for i in sr if any(g[i][j] in rare and g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(w))]
    mc=[j for j in sc if any(g[i][j] in rare and g[i][j]!=bg for i in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(mr,mr[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(mc,mc[1:]):
            cell=bg
            for col_,cells in cnt.most_common().items():
                if col_ in (bg,) : continue
                pts={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==col_}
                rs=[p[0] for p in pts if p[0] in mr]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts if p[1] in mc]
                if rs and cs:
                    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
                    if r0<=a<b<=r1 and c0<=c<d<=c1:
                        cell=col_; break
            row.append(cell)
        out.append(row)
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    pred=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k, pred, 'expected', exp, 'MATCH' if pred==exp else 'MISMATCH')

from collections import Counter

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: color with many cells forming near-full rows/cols; take second-most-common
    line=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    # marker color(s): rare colors
    markers=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n<=H]  # heuristic
    # sep rows: fraction of line-color >= 0.5
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for c in g[i] if c==line)>=W*0.5]

    # marker matrix
    MR=set(sr); MC=set(sc)
    M=[[None]*len(sc) for _ in range(len(sr))]
    for i in sr:
        for j in sc:
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=line and v!=bg and v in markers:
                M[sr.index(i)][MC.index(j)]=v
    print('marker matrix:')
    for r in M: print(r)
    # solid rectangles in M
    rects=[]
    if M and all(M[0]):
        # general: find maximal solid rectangles

            res=[]
            Hm=len(mat); Wm=len(mat[0])
            for i in range(Hm):
                for j in range(Wm):
                    if mat[i][j]==color:
                        # expand
                        a=i
                        while a<Hm and mat[a][j]==color: a+=1
                        b=j
                        while b<Wm and mat[i][b]==color: b+=1
                        c=a; d=b
                        while c<Hm and d<Wm and mat[c][d]==color:
                            # grow downward/rightward fully
                            while c<Hm and all(mat[r][d]==color for r in range(a,c+1)): c+=1
                            while d<Wm and all(mat[c][r]==color for r in range(b,d+1)): d+=1
                            # verify solid
                            if all(mat[r][q]==color for r in range(a,c+1) for q in range(b,d+1)):
                                res.append((a,c,b,d))
                        # backtrack? skip for now
                        i=a-1; j=d-1
            return res
        rects=find_rects(M,list(markers)[0])
        print('rects:',rects)
        # each rect -> (h-1)x(w-1) placed at top-left (lattice coords -> output)
        O=[[line]*0 for _ in range(0)]
        placed=[]
        for a,c,b,d in rects:

            sub=[[M[r][q] for q in range(b,d)] for r in range(a,c)]
            out_sub=[[sub[r][q] for q in range(ww-1)] for r in range(hh-1)]

        # canvas: union bbox

        # determine via accumulated

        for sub in placed:

        if not rows_used: return [[line]]
        r0,r1=min(rows_used),max(rows_used); c0,c1=min(cols_used),max(cols_used)
        O=[[line]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
        for sub in placed:
            rr=max(0,min(p[0] for p in placed)-0)
            # place at lattice top-left directly (lattice row a -> output row a - offset)
            pass
        return None
    return None
